sessions.phase_label: Collection brief and artwork scope definition
Artwork option review and visual revisions

requirements.title: Diagonal Basket-Weave Repeat Print
requirements.definition: An original, seamless diagonal basket-weave textile print with independently selectable texture, palette, diamond scale, edge treatment, and border treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the basket-weave artwork as one design mechanism; its scale, palette, texture, and border are attributes. Zebra and block-color pareos are separate because they are selected and revised independently.

requirements.title: Zebra Repeat Print
requirements.definition: An original, seamless zebra textile print with independently selectable direction, stripe scale, palette, contrast, texture, edge treatment, and border treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the zebra artwork and its visual attributes. The basket weave and block-color designs have independent option-selection, revision, and delivery trajectories.

requirements.title: Terracotta Block-Color Pareo
requirements.definition: A production artwork design for the terracotta or burgundy block-color pareo, including its interior color and border color and scale arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from the mustard version because each is a distinct delivered artwork that can require an independent color, border, or correction task. Border measurements remain attributes of this design.

requirements.title: Mustard Block-Color Pareo
requirements.definition: A production artwork design for the mustard block-color pareo, including its interior color and border color and scale arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from the terracotta version because the mustard artwork has its own observable color-placement failure and correction trajectory. Border dimensions and color placement are attributes of this design.

requirements.title: Artwork Dimensions and Seam Allowance
requirements.definition: The pareo production artwork must use the required physical dimensions and incorporate the supplier-compatible seam allowance needed for the intended finished size.
requirements.boundary_note: Dimensions and seam allowance form one geometry specification that can be changed through a standalone resizing task. Visual composition, border styling, color calibration, and file encoding remain outside this Requirement.

requirements.title: Print Color Specification
requirements.definition: Production files must carry suitable print-color information, including CMYK preparation and applicable supplier ICC or Pantone references for reproducing the approved palettes.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers technical color encoding, calibration, and reference documentation rather than the creative palette choices owned by each design Requirement.

requirements.title: Print-Ready File Output
requirements.definition: The approved artwork must be delivered as production-ready, supplier-usable files in the required print format and resolution.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers technical file readiness, format, and resolution as one output mechanism. Artwork dimensions and print-color calibration can be revised independently and therefore remain separate Requirements; optional bonus repeat tiles are not treated as an independently requested deliverable.
